name: document non-EU reverse-charge reviews
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_non_eu_reverse_charge_reviews (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id),
  document_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_sha256)=64),
  payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_sha256)=64),
  supplier_country_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(supplier_country_code)=2),
  supplier_evidence_reference TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(supplier_evidence_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
  supplier_evidence_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(supplier_evidence_sha256)=64),
  buyer_evidence_reference TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(buyer_evidence_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
  buyer_evidence_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(buyer_evidence_sha256)=64),
  service_evidence_reference TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(service_evidence_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
  service_evidence_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(service_evidence_sha256)=64),
  tax_period TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tax_period GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]'),
  deduction_percent REAL NOT NULL CHECK(deduction_percent > 0 AND deduction_percent <= 100),
  formal_deficiencies_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  rationale TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(rationale)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000),
  treatment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(treatment='non_eu_service_reverse_charge'),
  supersedes_review_sha256 TEXT CHECK(supersedes_review_sha256 IS NULL OR length(supersedes_review_sha256)=64),
  review_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(review_sha256)=64),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  principal TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  program TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(program)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS document_non_eu_reverse_charge_reviews_document_id ON document_non_eu_reverse_charge_reviews(document_id,id DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS document_non_eu_reverse_charge_reviews_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON document_non_eu_reverse_charge_reviews BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'non-EU reverse-charge reviews are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS document_non_eu_reverse_charge_reviews_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON document_non_eu_reverse_charge_reviews BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'non-EU reverse-charge reviews are append-only'); END;
